title:
What if owners of many homes
*paid more tax?*

lines.say: You are hoping for a bargain. Two MPs just suggested higher taxes on owners of many homes. Will they start selling cheap?
lines.cap: higher tax on owners of many homes. *will they sell cheap?*

lines.say: It's only a suggestion, not policy. But Singapore has seen this before.
lines.cap: only a suggestion, *not policy*. but we've seen this before

lines.say: In Budget 2022, tax on investment homes rose from up to 20%, to up to 36%.
lines.cap: Budget 2022: investment home tax up to 20% → *up to 36%*

lines.say: Did owners dump their units? No. Private prices kept rising in 2023 and 2024.
lines.cap: did owners dump units? no. *prices kept rising*

lines.say: Scenario one, most likely. Owners hold, and pass the cost on through higher rents.
lines.cap: scenario 1: owners hold and *pass it on through rent*

lines.say: Scenario two. Some sell slowly, mostly smaller units. Small unit buyers gain a little leverage.
lines.cap: scenario 2: some sell slowly. *small unit buyers gain a little*

lines.say: Scenario three, least likely. Everyone sells cheap at once. Owners of many homes can usually afford to wait.
lines.cap: scenario 3: everyone sells cheap. *owners can usually wait*

lines.say: So don't wait for a policy to hand you a bargain. Motivated sellers already exist. At MOP, at TOP, and at slow selling launches.
lines.cap: motivated sellers already exist: *MOP, TOP, slow launches*

lines.say: Which scenario do you think happens? Comment hold, sell, or rent up.
lines.cap: which happens? comment *HOLD, SELL or RENT UP*

caption:
Two MPs suggested higher taxes on owners of many homes. Will they start selling cheap? 🏘️

It's a suggestion, not policy. When investment home tax rose to up to 36% after Budget 2022, private prices still rose in 2023 and 2024. Most likely, owners hold and pass costs on through rent.

Which scenario do you think happens? Comment HOLD, SELL or RENT UP 👇

Scenarios only, not a forecast.
